calumba.definition:
n. The root of a plant (Jateorrhiza Calumba, and probably
   Cocculus palmatus), indigenous in Mozambique. It has an unpleasantly
   bitter taste, and is used as a tonic and antiseptic.

calumbic acid.translation:
[化] 咖伦巴酸; 咖伦巴根酸; 非洲防己根酸
[医] 非洲防己酸

calumbin.definition:
n. A bitter principle extracted as a white crystalline
   substance from the calumba root.
calumbin.translation:
[化] 非洲防己苦素; 咖伦宾; 咖伦巴根苷
[医] 非洲防己苦素

calumet.definition: n. a highly decorated ceremonial pipe of Amerindians; smoked on ceremonial occasions (especially as a token of peace)
calumet.translation: n. 长管烟斗(印第安人用)

calumniate.definition: v charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
calumniate.translation:
vt. 中伤, 诽谤
[法] 诬蔑, 诽谤, 中伤

calumniated.translation: v. 诽谤, 中伤( calumniate的过去式和过去分词 )

calumniates.definition: v charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
calumniates.translation: v. 诽谤, 中伤( calumniate的第三人称单数 )

calumniating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Calumniate
calumniating.translation: v. 诽谤, 中伤( calumniate的现在分词 )

calumniation.definition: n a false accusation of an offense or a malicious misrepresentation of someone's words or actions
calumniation.translation:
n. 诽谤, 中伤
[法] 诬告, 诽谤, 中伤

calumniator.translation:
n. 中伤者, 诽谤者
[法] 诬告者, 诽谤者, 中伤者

calumniatory.definition: s. (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
calumniatory.translation:
a. 诽谤的, 中伤的
[法] 诬告的, 诽谤者, 中伤的

calumnies.translation: n. 诬蔑, 诽谤, 中伤（的话）( calumny的名词复数 )

calumnious.definition: s (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
calumnious.translation: a. 惯于中伤的, 惯于诬蔑的

calumniously.definition: r in a false and slanderous and defamatory manner; with slander or calumny
calumniously.translation: adv. 诽谤地; 中伤地

calumny.definition:
n a false accusation of an offense or a malicious misrepresentation of someone's words or actions
n an abusive attack on a person's character or good name
calumny.translation:
n. 诽谤, 中伤
[法] 诬告, 诽谤, 中伤

calutron.translation:
n. 卡留管
[化] 电磁同位素分离器; 电磁型同位素分离器
